title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 3 (Dushanbe-Uzbekistan Border) Improvement Project

description.narrative: CAREC Corridor 3 covers almost 7,000 km of roads and runs across Central Asia in the north-south direction, linking the Russian Federation to the Persian Gulf. The corridor serves as a main conduit for regional and international trade. The project will complete the corridor's missing link in Tajikistan's territory - the section from Dushanbe to the Uzbekistan border. This will help further reduce transport cost and travel time, and increase regional and transit trade.

description.narrative: Improved connectivity and mobility along the Tajikistan sections of CAREC Corridor 3

Traffic volume from Dushanbe to the Dusti border crossing point increased to 25,000 vpd by 2015 from 11,000 vpd in 2009 Progress/Status: Road civil works contract was awarded in September 2011 and construction progress was completed in mid-2015. Measurement of the performance indicator will be done as part of the Executing Agencies' Project Completion Report. Data Source: Statistics from MOTC, Customs Services, and Ministry of Internal Affairs Actual value:

Waiting time for freight at the Dusti border crossing point reduced by 30% by 2015 from an average of 15 hours in 2009 Progress/Status: Upgrading works at the Dusti customs post has been completed and the taking-over certificate was issued in June 2014. Installation of a weigh bridge has been completed. Measurement of the performance indicator will be done during project completion report. Actual value:

Traffic accidents on the project road reduced by 30 incidences by 2015 from 67 in 2009 Progress/Status: Traffic audit is planned to be implemented to assess road safety performance after completion of the project. Actual value:

Cross-border trade via the Dusti border crossing point increased to 11,830 tons by 2015 from 6,709 tons in 2008 Progress/Status: Upgrading works at the Dusti customs post has been completed and the taking-over certificate was issued in June 2014. Installation of a weigh bridge has been completed. Measurement of the performance indicator will be done during project completion report. Data Source: Annual traffic accident reports from the Traffic Police Department Actual value:
